Definition: a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret
BiblicalUsage: A secret is the counsel of those who sit close together, and Jacob says his soul will not come into the secret of Simeon and Levi. Eliphaz asks Job if he has heard the secret of God, and the psalm says the secret of the LORD is with those who fear Him. Proverbs says the froward are an abomination, but His secret is with the righteous.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's secret is not hidden from His people; it is hidden for them, given to those who fear Him. The wicked have their own secret counsels, and they end in violence, but the secret of the LORD ends in friendship. My position is that intimacy with God is the reward of the fear of the LORD.
RelatedTopics: Friendship with Christ; Fear of the Lord; Wisdom
